newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia McDonald's says '96 sales up 60 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia McDonald's says '96 sales up 60 pct.

text.p: The Slovenian branch of McDonald's said on Friday its sales rose to 1.2 billion tolars ($7.8 million) in 1996 from 750 million tolars a year earlier, but refused to reveal profit figures.

The company, which opened its first restaurant in Slovenia in December 1993, said sales were up mainly due to the opening of three new restaurants in Slovenia last year, taking the total number of restaurants to eight.
It said it would open four new restaurants in Slovenia this year as investment would rise to $4.0 million from $3.3 million in 1996.

The total number of customers at Slovenian McDonald's restaurants rose by 35 percent to 2.5 million in 1996 and the company said it expected to have about four million customers this year. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
